items.name: a-colony-worker
items.refnote: the first image is the unit as it is in the game (keep its design: what it carries and wears); the second is the faction board (its materials and finish); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
items.subject: the ANT WORKER, who gathers and builds: a sturdy rust-orange worker ant with big black eyes, short ivory mandibles and antennae, a woven bark-and-twig carrying frame strapped on its back rising behind its head, a small red leaf scarf, a stone-headed pick over its shoulder.

items.name: a-worker
items.refnote: the first image is the unit as it is in the game (keep its design); the second is the faction board (its materials and finish); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
items.subject: the YOUNG ANT, a small colony villager: a young, slender rust-orange ant with big black eyes, tall antennae and small ivory mandibles, a simple red leaf sash, holding a little wooden tool, looking eager.

items.name: a-warrior
items.subject: the ANT WARRIOR, the ants' basic melee soldier (the axe-wielding ants in the middle of the reference board): a rust-orange ant head with big black eyes, ivory mandible tusks and antennae, a mantle of deep red maple leaves on its shoulders, and the ivory bone axe blade raised beside its head.

items.name: a-archer
items.subject: the ANT ARCHER (the hooded archers at the top of the reference board): a slim rust-orange ant under a deep red maple-leaf hood, big black eyes in its shadow, drawing its curved bark-and-bone bow, the bow's upper limb and an ivory-tipped arrow beside its head, a quiver of feathered arrows on its back.

items.name: a-thornblade
items.subject: the THORNBLADE, a fast ant duellist (the ants with two curved blades on the reference board's sides): a lean rust-orange ant with a spiky red leaf crest, big black eyes, crossing two long curved ivory thorn blades in front of its face.

items.name: a-silkwarden
items.subject: the SILKWARDEN, who binds enemies in silk (the ant with the net and big spool at the reference board's upper left): a rust-orange ant in a red leaf hood with big black eyes, a huge cream silk spool on its back, a forked staff with a silk net held up beside it.

items.name: a-hunter
items.refnote: the first image is the unit as it is in the game (keep its design); the second is the faction board (its materials and finish); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
items.subject: the HUNTER, a charging ant spearman: a rust-orange ant with an acorn-cap helmet over big black eyes, ivory mandibles, a red leaf mantle, an ivory-tipped spear raised upright beside its head and a small round bark shield.

items.name: a-bombardier
items.refnote: the first image is the unit as it is in the game (keep its design); the second is the faction board (the big pod-carrier at its top: its materials and finish); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
items.subject: the BOMBARDIER, the ants' siege thrower: a stocky rust-orange ant with big black eyes and ivory tusks, a big bark-and-chitin launcher tube mounted over its shoulder, a cluster of round cream seed-pod shells on its back, red leaf straps.

items.name: a-nectarist
items.subject: the NECTARIST, the ants' healer (the ant with gourds and seed-head staff at the reference board's right): a rust-orange ant under a wide red maple-leaf hat, big black eyes, holding up a small gourd that drips glowing golden nectar, a seed-head staff behind.

items.name: a-banneret
items.refnote: the first image is the unit as it is in the game (keep its design); the second is the faction board (its materials and finish); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
items.subject: the BANNERET, the ants' standard-bearer: a proud rust-orange ant with big black eyes and ivory mandibles, a red leaf mantle, holding a tall staff whose deep red banner with a simple ivory ant-head sigil flies above and behind its head.

items.name: a-amber-adept
items.refnote: the first image is the unit as it is in the game (keep its design); the second is the faction board (its materials and finish); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
items.subject: the AMBER ADEPT, an ant mage who seals magic in amber: a slender rust-orange ant with big black eyes and a red cloth headband, faint blue-violet veins glowing on its chitin, holding up a twisted root staff crowned with a glowing orange amber stone beside its head.

items.name: a-queensguard
items.subject: the QUEENSGUARD, the ants' elite shield guard (the big shield ants at the bottom of the reference board): a heavy rust-orange ant with ivory tusks and big black eyes under a red leaf mantle, behind the top of its tall bark-rimmed red maple-leaf tower shield, an ivory spear point rising beside its head.

items.name: a-winglancer
items.subject: the WINGLANCER, a flying ant lancer (the winged ants at the reference board's top corners): a rust-orange winged ant with big black eyes and a red leaf collar, its translucent amber wings spread wide behind it, a long ivory-tipped lance held level across the frame.

items.name: a-rootweaver
items.refnote: the first image is the unit as it is in the game (keep its design); the second is the faction board (its materials and finish); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
items.subject: the ROOTWEAVER, an ant root-shaper changed by substance: a lanky rust-orange ant cloaked in a crown of tall red leaves, big black eyes, faint blue-violet glowing veins on its chitin, living roots twisting around its forearms and up a gnarled root staff.

items.name: a-marshal
items.refnote: the first image is the hero as it is in the game (keep its design); the second is the faction board (its materials and finish); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
items.subject: the ANT MARSHAL, the ants' commander hero: a broad, battle-hardened rust-orange ant with big black eyes and long ivory tusks, a crown-like crest of red maple leaves and amber stones, a deep red cape over chitin pauldrons, the head of a heavy amber-studded war mace resting on its shoulder.

items.name: a-rootbreaker
items.refnote: the first image is the hero as it is in the game (keep its design); the second is the faction board (the big ant at its bottom centre with the vine-wrapped boulder: its materials and finish); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
items.subject: the ROOTBREAKER, the ants' brute hero: a huge, hulking rust-orange ant with big black eyes and massive ivory tusks, a heavy mane of red leaves on its shoulders, a grey boulder club bound in thick living roots and vines hoisted over its shoulder.

items.name: a-queensguard-hall
items.refnote: the first image is the building as it is in the game (keep its shape); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
items.subject: the QUEENSGUARD HALL, the ants' main hall: a great long hall of dark timber and bark under a sweeping roof of overlapping deep red maple leaves, huge ivory tusks curving up from its ridge and flanking the arched door.

items.name: a-leaf-garrison
items.refnote: the first image is the building as it is in the game (keep its shape); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
items.subject: the BARRACKS, the ants' leaf garrison: a long timber barracks under a steep roof of overlapping red maple leaves, ivory tusks framing the doorway, a rack of bone spears by the wall.

items.name: a-chitin-workshop
items.refnote: the first image is the building as it is in the game (keep its shape); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
items.subject: the CHITIN WORKS, the ants' armoury: an open timber workshop under a red maple-leaf roof, shaped chitin plates and bone blades hanging on its wall, a stone anvil and a warm ember glow inside.

items.name: a-silk-brood-house
items.refnote: the first image is the building as it is in the game (keep its shape); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
items.subject: the MOUND, the ants' brood house (supply): a small round grown earthen mound with a low timber doorway, roofed with red maple leaves, cream silk cocoons tucked under its eaves.

items.name: a-watchtower
items.refnote: the first image is the building as it is in the game (keep its shape); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
items.subject: the WATCHTOWER, the ants' guard tower: a tall slender tower of lashed timber and grass stems with a lookout platform under a pointed roof of red maple leaves, ivory spikes around the platform. Tall in the frame.

items.name: a-rootworks
items.refnote: the first image is the building as it is in the game (keep its footprint); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
items.subject: the ROOTWORKS, where ants draw substance from roots: a timber platform built around a thick tapped root, wooden vats and troughs collecting glowing blue-violet sap, a red maple-leaf canopy over it.

items.name: a-bombardier-workshop
items.refnote: the first image is the building as it is in the game (keep its shape); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
items.subject: the BOMBARDIER WORKSHOP: a sturdy timber workshop under a red maple-leaf roof, two big bark launcher tubes mounted on its roof, piles of round cream seed-pod shells beside it.

items.name: a-forester
items.refnote: the first image is the building as it is today (keep its idea); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
items.subject: the FORESTER LODGE: a cosy timber hut under a red maple-leaf roof, a stack of cut twig logs and a sapling nursery bed beside its door, a lantern glowing warm.

items.name: a-acorn-hall
items.refnote: the first image is an older version of this building (keep only its idea); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
items.subject: the GREAT ACORN HALL, the ants' upgraded main hall: a grand hall grown out of a giant acorn, its cap a domed roof, red maple-leaf banners and ivory tusks around its arched timber gate.

items.name: a-amber-sanctuary
items.subject: the AMBER SANCTUARY, an ant shrine: a round timber and bark shrine under a red maple-leaf roof, open on its front, a large glowing orange amber stone resting on a carved altar inside, ivory tusks framing the entrance.

items.name: a-marshal-carapace
items.subject: IRON CARAPACE, the Marshal hardens his chitin and reflects blows: a rust-orange ant's armoured chitin shoulder hardened to a dark iron sheen, an enemy blade shattering against it with bright white sparks flying back. Energy colour: steel grey and white.

items.name: a-marshal-crownfall
items.subject: CROWNFALL, the Marshal's ultimate: a huge glowing amber crown falling from the sky onto the ground, slamming down in a ring-shaped shockwave of orange light and flying earth. Energy colour: amber orange and gold.

items.name: a-marshal-faultline
items.subject: FAULTLINE, the Marshal slams his mace to send a fracture through enemies: a war mace head striking the ground in the lower left, a glowing orange crack racing diagonally away through the earth, chunks of rock thrown up along it. Energy colour: hot orange.

items.name: a-marshal-rally
items.subject: RALLY THE COLONY, the Marshal's aura of speed: a deep red maple-leaf war banner with an ivory ant-head sigil standing in the centre, golden wind streaks sweeping around it in a ring. Energy colour: warm gold and red.

items.name: a-rootbreaker-presence
items.subject: CRUSHING PRESENCE, the Rootbreaker's aura that weakens enemy armour: the hulking ant's silhouette looming in the centre, a heavy ring of dark roots around it pressing down, cracks spreading in an enemy chitin plate in the foreground. Energy colour: dull red and dark violet.

items.name: a-rootbreaker-roar
items.subject: CHALLENGE ROAR, the Rootbreaker taunts nearby enemies: the brute ant's head in profile with mandibles flung wide open, roaring, visible rings of sound blasting outward. Energy colour: fiery red-orange.

items.name: a-rootbreaker-skullcrack
items.subject: SKULLCRACK, a heavy overhead strike that stuns: the root-bound boulder club smashing down from the top of the frame onto a dark enemy helmet that cracks, a burst of white impact light and small stun stars. Energy colour: white and orange.

items.name: a-rootbreaker-uproot
items.subject: UPROOT, the Rootbreaker smashes the ground: thick gnarled roots and slabs of stone erupting violently upward out of the cracked earth, dust and debris flying. Energy colour: earthy orange with dark brown.

items.name: a-amber-seal
items.subject: AMBER SEAL, silences an enemy's spellcasting: a dark enemy insect's head encased in a block of glowing orange amber, its magic frozen inside as a dull violet swirl. Energy colour: amber orange.

items.name: a-amber-sever
items.subject: AMBER SEVER, strips an enemy's magic buffs: a glowing amber blade of light slicing diagonally through a ring of violet magic light that shatters into fragments. Energy colour: amber orange cutting through violet.

items.name: a-rallying-standard
items.subject: RALLYING STANDARD, raises the colony standard to boost allies' damage: a deep red banner with an ivory ant-head sigil being thrust upward, its pole planted, flapping in a gust, red-gold light bursting behind it. Energy colour: red and gold.

items.name: a-nectar-mend
items.subject: NECTAR MEND, heals an ally: a single big drop of glowing golden nectar falling from a tilted gourd, splashing into soft golden healing light. Energy colour: warm gold.

items.name: a-nectar-cleanse
items.subject: NECTAR CLEANSE, washes harmful effects from an ally: a swirl of clear golden nectar washing over a rust-orange ant's chitin arm, dark violet-black blight dissolving away into fading wisps. Energy colour: clear gold and white.

items.name: a-royal-guard
items.subject: ROYAL GUARD, an aura of armour for nearby allies: a tall bark-rimmed red maple-leaf tower shield standing upright in the centre, a calm dome of warm golden light around it. Energy colour: gold.

items.name: a-shield-brace
items.subject: SHIELD BRACE, the Queensguard braces behind its shield: a bark-rimmed red maple-leaf tower shield seen head-on, planted into the ground, enemy thorns and arrows glancing off its face in white sparks. Energy colour: steel and white.

items.name: a-briar-patch
items.subject: BRIAR PATCH, grows a field of thorny roots that slows and hurts enemies: a dense ring of thorny brambles and roots bursting out of the ground, sharp thorns and a faint blue-violet glow in the roots. Energy colour: dark red-brown with blue-violet.

items.name: a-root-bind
items.subject: ROOT BIND, entangles an enemy: thick living roots coiling tightly up around a dark enemy insect's legs and body, pinning it to the ground, a faint blue-violet glow in the roots. Energy colour: blue-violet.

items.name: a-silken-snare
items.subject: SILKEN SNARE, binds an enemy in silk and grounds flyers: a cream silk net flung wide across the frame, wrapping a dark winged enemy insect and pulling it down, strands glinting. Energy colour: pale cream and soft blue.

items.name: a-thorn-rush
items.subject: THORN RUSH, the Thornblade's lunge: two curved ivory thorn blades slashing diagonally forward with motion streaks, a rust-orange ant arm behind them, a bright slash trail. Energy colour: red and white.

items.name: a-research-broadheads
items.subject: BROADHEADS (archers deal more damage): three arrows with wide, razor-sharp ivory-bone broadhead tips and red leaf fletching, fanned out.

items.name: a-research-campaign-harness
items.subject: CAMPAIGN HARNESS (the hero gains health): a sturdy harness of thick chitin plates and leather straps with bone buckles and a red leaf pauldron.

items.name: a-research-driving-spear
items.subject: DRIVING SPEAR (hunters charge more often): a long spear with a heavy barbed ivory point and a red leaf binding below the head, angled diagonally, a short motion streak behind the point.

items.name: a-research-reinforced-carapace
items.subject: REINFORCED CARAPACE (warriors gain health and armour): a thick rust-orange chitin chest plate layered with a second plate of hardened bark, bound by bone studs.

items.name: a-research-saturating-shells
items.subject: SATURATING SHELLS (the bombardier's blast grows and slows more): a round cream seed-pod shell, cracked open, oozing thick glowing golden sticky sap.

items.name: a-research-serrated-tools
items.subject: SERRATED TOOLS (workers gather faster): a worker's stone-and-bone hatchet with a jagged serrated ivory edge, a few wood chips flying.
